example: You did an excellent job on the project.
exampleTranslation: 你在这个项目上做得非常出色。

example: Everyone came except Tom.
exampleTranslation: 除了汤姆，大家都来了。

example: The school trip excited the children.
exampleTranslation: 学校旅行让孩子们很兴奋。

example: There was great excitement before the match.
exampleTranslation: 比赛前大家都非常兴奋。

example: Please excuse me for being late.
exampleTranslation: 请原谅我迟到了。

example: Regular exercise keeps your heart healthy.
exampleTranslation: 经常锻炼能保持心脏健康。

example: We expect the bus to arrive soon.
exampleTranslation: 我们预计公交车很快到达。

example: The trip was an experience I will never forget.
exampleTranslation: 这次旅行是我永远不会忘记的经历。

example: The expert showed us how to repair the machine.
exampleTranslation: 专家向我们展示了如何修理机器。

example: Can you explain this maths problem to me?
exampleTranslation: 你能给我解释这道数学题吗？

example: We explored the cave with a guide.
exampleTranslation: 我们在导游带领下探索了洞穴。

example: The explorer travelled across the desert.
exampleTranslation: 探险家穿越了沙漠。

example: It is important to express your feelings politely.
exampleTranslation: 礼貌地表达感受很重要。

example: Her expression changed when she heard the news.
exampleTranslation: 听到消息后她的表情变了。

example: The fact is that practice makes progress.
exampleTranslation: 事实是练习会带来进步。

example: Do not give up if you fail the first time.
exampleTranslation: 第一次失败也不要放弃。

example: The teacher gave everyone a fair chance.
exampleTranslation: 老师给每个人一个公平的机会。

example: The players cared about fairness in the game.
exampleTranslation: 球员们重视比赛中的公平。

example: The children read a fairy tale before bed.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们睡前读了一个童话故事。

example: She faithfully followed the instructions.
exampleTranslation: 她忠实地遵循了说明。

example: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
exampleTranslation: 秋天树叶从树上落下。

example: I usually fall asleep after reading.
exampleTranslation: 我通常读书后就睡着了。

example: He missed many lessons and fell behind the class.
exampleTranslation: 他错过了许多课，落在了班级后面。

example: Be careful not to fall down on the wet floor.
exampleTranslation: 小心别在湿地板上摔倒。

example: The two characters fall in love in the story.
exampleTranslation: 故事中的两个角色相爱了。

example: She fell in love with the quiet seaside town.
exampleTranslation: 她爱上了那座安静的海滨小镇。

example: The little boy fell over while running.
exampleTranslation: 小男孩跑步时绊倒了。

example: The fallen leaves covered the path.
exampleTranslation: 落叶覆盖了小路。

example: The singer found fame after the competition.
exampleTranslation: 这位歌手在比赛后成名了。

example: Please write your family name first.
exampleTranslation: 请先写你的姓。

example: We made a family tree for history class.
exampleTranslation: 我们为历史课制作了一张家谱。

example: The city is famous for its beautiful gardens.
exampleTranslation: 这座城市以美丽的花园闻名。

example: He is a big fan of basketball.
exampleTranslation: 他是篮球迷。

example: We had a fantastic time at the concert.
exampleTranslation: 我们在音乐会上玩得非常开心。

example: The village is far away from the city.
exampleTranslation: 这个村庄离城市很远。

example: My uncle works on a large farm.
exampleTranslation: 我叔叔在一个大农场工作。

example: The farmer feeds the cows every morning.
exampleTranslation: 农民每天早上给奶牛喂食。

example: Modern farming uses less water.
exampleTranslation: 现代农业用水更少。

example: The library is farther than the supermarket.
exampleTranslation: 图书馆比超市更远。

example: The museum has a fascinating dinosaur exhibition.
exampleTranslation: 博物馆有一个迷人的恐龙展览。

example: The cat became fat after eating too much.
exampleTranslation: 这只猫吃太多后变胖了。

example: It was my fault that we missed the bus.
exampleTranslation: 我们错过公交车是我的过错。

example: The child overcame his fear of water.
exampleTranslation: 这个孩子克服了对水的恐惧。

example: I feel much better after a good sleep.
exampleTranslation: 好好睡了一觉后我感觉好多了。

example: Feel free to ask questions during the talk.
exampleTranslation: 讲座期间可以随便提问。

example: I feel like walking by the river.
exampleTranslation: 我想沿河散步。

example: She shared her feelings about the new school.
exampleTranslation: 她分享了对新学校的感受。

example: He stayed home because he had a fever.
exampleTranslation: 他因为发烧待在家里。

example: I enjoy reading science fiction.
exampleTranslation: 我喜欢读科幻小说。

example: The children played football in the field.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们在田野里踢足球。

example: Our class went on a field trip to the museum.
exampleTranslation: 我们班去博物馆进行了一次校外参观。

example: Fill the bottle with clean water.
exampleTranslation: 把瓶子装满干净的水。

example: We finally found the missing key.
exampleTranslation: 我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。

example: Can you find my blue notebook?
exampleTranslation: 你能找到我的蓝色笔记本吗？

example: We need to find out what happened.
exampleTranslation: 我们需要查清发生了什么。

example: Please finish your homework before dinner.
exampleTranslation: 请在晚饭前完成作业。

example: My first name is Li.
exampleTranslation: 我的名字是李。

example: First of all, wash your hands.
exampleTranslation: 首先，洗洗你的手。

example: These shoes fit me well.
exampleTranslation: 这双鞋很合脚。

example: Can you fix the broken lamp?
exampleTranslation: 你能修好坏掉的灯吗？

example: We fixed up the old room for the visitors.
exampleTranslation: 我们为访客修整了旧房间。

example: The national flag flew above the school.
exampleTranslation: 国旗在学校上空飘扬。

example: Take a flashlight when you walk in the dark.
exampleTranslation: 在黑暗中行走时带上手电筒。

example: Our flight leaves at six tomorrow morning.
exampleTranslation: 我们的航班明早六点起飞。

example: Heavy rain caused a flood near the river.
exampleTranslation: 大雨在河边造成了洪水。

example: The children fly a kite on windy days.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们在有风的日子放风筝。

example: It was foggy, so we drove slowly.
exampleTranslation: 天气有雾，所以我们开得很慢。

example: Fold the paper in half.
exampleTranslation: 把纸对折。

example: We listened to folk music at the festival.
exampleTranslation: 我们在节日上听了民间音乐。

example: Some sports, for example swimming, are good for health.
exampleTranslation: 一些运动，例如游泳，有益健康。

example: I know for sure that she is coming.
exampleTranslation: 我确定她会来。

example: The strong wind forced the door open.
exampleTranslation: 强风把门吹开了。

example: True friends can stay together forever.
exampleTranslation: 真正的朋友可以永远在一起。

example: Do not forget to bring your homework.
exampleTranslation: 别忘了带作业。

example: Please fill in this form carefully.
exampleTranslation: 请认真填写这张表格。

example: Please forward this message to the group.
exampleTranslation: 请把这条消息转发到群里。

example: The school was founded in 1980.
exampleTranslation: 这所学校成立于1980年。

example: Are you free after school today?
exampleTranslation: 你今天放学后有空吗？

example: It is freezing outside, so wear a warm coat.
exampleTranslation: 外面很冷，所以穿件暖和的外套。

example: Honest conversations can strengthen friendship.
exampleTranslation: 坦诚的交流能增进友谊。

example: The loud noise frightened the baby.
exampleTranslation: 巨大的噪音吓到了宝宝。

example: The frightened dog hid under the table.
exampleTranslation: 受惊的狗躲在桌子下面。

example: From now on, I will check my work twice.
exampleTranslation: 从现在起，我会检查作业两遍。

example: We visit the museum from time to time.
exampleTranslation: 我们偶尔参观博物馆。

example: The shop is open from nine to six.
exampleTranslation: 商店从九点营业到六点。

example: The train runs from Beijing to Shanghai.
exampleTranslation: 火车从北京开往上海。

example: The long delay frustrated the passengers.
exampleTranslation: 长时间延误让乘客很沮丧。

example: The bus is full, so we must wait.
exampleTranslation: 公交车满了，所以我们必须等下一班。

example: The garden is full of colourful flowers.
exampleTranslation: 花园里开满了五颜六色的花。

example: She wants to work with animals in the future.
exampleTranslation: 她将来想和动物一起工作。

example: The gatekeeper checked our tickets.
exampleTranslation: 门卫检查了我们的票。

example: The general plan is ready for discussion.
exampleTranslation: 总体计划已经准备好讨论。

example: Her generosity helped many families.
exampleTranslation: 她的慷慨帮助了许多家庭。

example: He is learning German at school.
exampleTranslation: 他在学校学习德语。

example: We got a surprise when the lights went out.
exampleTranslation: 灯熄灭时我们感到惊讶。

example: I will get back home before dark.
exampleTranslation: 我会在天黑前回家。

example: Please get down from the wall carefully.
exampleTranslation: 请小心从墙上下来。

example: Do not let fear get in the way of your dreams.
exampleTranslation: 不要让恐惧妨碍你的梦想。

example: She got into the school bus quickly.
exampleTranslation: 她迅速上了校车。

example: Dad gets mad when I leave the door open.
exampleTranslation: 我敞着门时爸爸会生气。
